capabilities: Add cards by name, set code or Cardmarket link
Track variants, condition and graded slabs
Fetch Cardmarket and TCGplayer prices per variant
Show set completion, dashboard, gallery and price history
Import and export CSV from Collectr, TCGplayer and Cardmarket
extras: Free and MIT-licensed; no account, API key, telemetry or ads. Collection data stays in a plain Markdown table between plugin markers; beta builds via BRAT; Ko-fi support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track a trading-card collection with print variants, market prices and set completion.

relations.evidence: Card data, images and prices come from the free, open TCGdex API.
Cardmarket (EUR) or TCGplayer (USD), priced per variant and adjusted for condition.

summary: Track a Pokémon TCG collection in plain Markdown tables with card search, variants, live prices, set completion and a dashboard.
